subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a dragonborn who recognizes Eldeth's voice and dispels the darkness, later picking up the statue of Demogorgon and reflecting on 'Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - ...'
source_quote: He stands in the darkness. He hears nothing. Then he hears a shout. “Is everyone okay?” Zalthir recognizes the voice; it’s Eldeth. Zalthir sighs and dispels the darkness. ... Zalthir tenses. “Oh, yes, I am Pelek. I seem to have occupied this body.” “The ghost,” he thinks. ... Zalthir jumps off the mesa and heads to an alcove in the northeast corner. There, he picks up the statue of Demogorgon. “Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - …” he thinks to himself.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is the voice Zalthir recognizes shouting, “Is everyone okay?” and is later seen near the tunnel entrance with a creature similar to a beholder.
source_quote: He hears nothing. Then he hears a shout. “Is everyone okay?” Zalthir recognizes the voice; it’s Eldeth. ... Where Eldeth is, near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouts, “Yes, we’re all fine.” and later finds a giant baby rattle made by Clan Thrazgad, which he rattles and expresses desire for a dragon.
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “Yes, we’re all fine.” ... Thorin shouts, “Look what I found.” ... He examines it further, “It says made by clan Thrazgad.” ... Thorin rattles it some more, “We should get a baby dragon. I would like to have a dragon. It would be so cool if we had a dragon.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouts, “I have the egg.” and later uses dancing lights to intimidate Derro, and proposes the name “The Ember Vanguard.”
source_quote: Daz shouts, “I have the egg.” ... Daz turns to him, “No.” ... Daz is very pleased with his use of dancing lights and the effect it had on the Derro. ... And then he smiles, “I have it - The Ember Vanguard.”

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek is an unfamiliar Derro voice who says, “My goodness, this body is uncomfortable.” and later identifies as having occupied the body, saying, “I am Pelek. I seem to have occupied this body.”
source_quote: And then an unfamiliar voice of a Derro shouts, “My goodness, this body is uncomfortable.” ... “Oh, yes, I am Pelek. I seem to have occupied this body.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reads Pliinki’s journal and is disturbed by the egg, recalls Bahamut’s teaching about freedom of choice, and declares they must return the egg to Gartokkar to prevent its demonic transformation.
source_quote: Grygum reads what Zalthir has found and is disturbed. And the egg disturbs him further. ... He remembers some text from the temple where he learned of the power of Bahamut - “When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.” ... “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar,” he declares.

source_quote: The monk looks around. The upper levels of the mesa are covered in blood and the broken bodies of the derro. Where Eldeth is, near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.

subject: Pliinki's Journal
fact: Pliinki's Journal details her experiments with the Obelisk of Diirinka and the Red Dragon Egg, intending to create a two-headed wyrmling as a mount for Demogorgon and use the Obelisk to conquer Gracklstugh.
source_quote:
Pliinki's Journal
**Day 17 – The Stone of Diirinka**
The Obelisk. Such a magnificent, fractured thing! Hidden here by Diirinka himself, I am certain. Its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, a power just waiting to be unleashed. I have tried the Thrazgad ore, as Narrak suggested, to mend its cracks, but it merely sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches. ... It will conquer Gracklstugh, just as I plan. ... Today, I touched it with a spark of my own will, and it flashed! A mere flicker, but a sign! A squeal of glee escaped me. ... 
**Day 25 – The Prince's Gift Arrives**
The Gray Ghosts delivered it! The Red Dragon Egg! ... This is no mere insurance policy; it is the vessel for my greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself. ... My goal is clear, a two-headed wyrmling, a perfect "Prince's gift" for Demogorgon, to serve as his mount. ... The transformation will make it *perfect*.
**Day 47 – The Obelisk Responds**
I pressed my hand to the Obelisk again, channeling the energy of the Whorlstone Tunnels into its fractures. It didn't just flash this time; the very air around it flared! It hungers for more power, more chaos! This monolith will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
**Day 54 – Anticipation and Destiny**
The egg is nearing its time! ... My "creation" for Demogorgon will soon be revealed. The Obelisk, too, senses the coming shift. Its purpose, alongside the egg, is to herald the Prince's arrival and the "genocidal war" that will cleanse this city.

subject: Letter 1: From Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki writes to Uskvil confirming the egg’s delivery by the Gray Ghosts, the failure of Thrazgad ore to mend the Obelisk, and the plan to use the Obelisk and egg to conquer Gracklstugh as a gift to Demogorgon.
source_quote:
***To: Uskvil, Master Thief***
*The Egg has arrived! Your operatives, those foolish Gray Ghosts, delivered it precisely as planned, though they do not comprehend the true glory of their retrieval. ... The mutations are taking hold, just as my notes predicted. Soon, the two-headed wyrmling will be ready to serve as our Prince's mount. ... The Thrazgad ore ... stubbornly sitting "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches. We must find a way to mend its fractures, for it is the key to conquering Gracklstugh and offering it as a sacrificial gift to our Lord.*

subject: Letter 2: From Aliinka to Pliinki
fact: Aliinka, of the Council of Savants / Gray Ghosts, confirms the success of the egg and ore retrieval, the manipulation of the Deepking and Stone Guard, and the indoctrination of the Council through 'Y' carvings to prepare Gracklstugh for the coming ascension.
source_quote:
***To: Pliinki, Most Devoted***
*Your updates on the Prince's Gift are... stimulating. ... Uskvil confirmed the successful retrieval of both the dragon egg and the Clan Thrazgad ore, as ordered. ... Our operatives ... ensure the whispers of dissent spread like contagion. ... Almost all members have now embraced the true path, thanks to our careful placements of the 'Y' carvings. The city spirals precisely as we planned, preparing for the true glory that awaits it.*

subject: Letter 3: From Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki expresses frustration that Thrazgad ore failed to mend the Obelisk, reaffirms the egg’s near-completion as a demonic mount for Demogorgon, and urges continued destabilization of the Deepking’s authority.
source_quote:
***To: Uskvil, My Resolute Assistant***
*My frustration with the Obelisk grows. That acid-resistant ore ... has proven useless in mending its cracks. It still sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches. ... Meanwhile, the egg flourishes! The two-headed mutation is nearly complete, a testament to the Prince's foresight and my dedication. ... Ensure the Deepking's hit list remains in the assassins' hands. The chaos it creates serves to further erode his authority and prepare the populace for what is to come.*

subject: Letter 4: From Narrak to Pliinki
fact: Narrak, the Cult Leader, praises the destabilization of Gracklstugh, the distraction of the Keepers, and confirms the Obelisk and egg as the instruments of ascension to deliver the city as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
source_quote:
***To: Pliinki, My Inspired Disciple***
*The seeds we've sown are bearing fruit, Pliinki. ... The Keepers of the Flame are utterly distracted by the loss of the egg ... They have no idea it is destined to serve a far greater purpose ... Your work with the Obelisk and the egg is paramount. This ancient monolith, once repaired, will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon. ... The "genocidal war" against the derro that Gartokkar so desires will merely be the first cleansing.*

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is the name chosen by Daz for the group, adopted by all members, and later claimed by a Drow Archmage who summons a meteor swarm to intimidate Derro guards, marking their passage out of the cave.
source_quote: And then he smiles, “I have it - The Ember Vanguard.” ... The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!” ... Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: double doors in the cave tunnel
fact: A pair of double doors are encountered at the end of a cave tunnel, guarded by a squad of Derro who are intimidated into letting The Ember Vanguard pass.
source_quote: They go down a different cave tunnel, which leads to a pair of double doors. In front of those double doors is a small squad of derro.

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin is a Derro guard at the double doors who, upon seeing a Drow Archmage summon a meteor swarm, surrenders and lets The Ember Vanguard pass, fearing a larger Drow incursion.
source_quote: Diirdeklin has been at this guard post for days. ... There is a noise coming from the north. ... The creatures are advancing, as if they own this place. ... He reaches for the alarm. And then he hears a booming voice - “The people you are trying to warn are dead.” ... He stops. He just wants to live. ... The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!” ... Diirdeklin ... shouts, “Yes, pass!”

subject: Diinarnnmyr
fact: Diinarnnmyr is a Derro who misinterprets The Ember Vanguard as a Drow-Duergar alliance and mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”
source_quote: As they leave Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: Gartokkar

source_quote: The Deepking remains blissfully unaware of his true vulnerability. ... The Deepking's increased reliance on the Empty-Scabbard Killers for his wanton assassinations only serves our purpose. ... We shall return the egg to Gartokkar.

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull is the Captain of the Stone Guard who is consumed by her own conspiracy theories, hunting phantoms while the true power shifts beneath her, aiding the Cult’s destabilization efforts.
source_quote: Captain Blackskull of the Stone Guard, in her own misguided paranoia, is actively searching for "corruption", unwittingly aiding our efforts to sow discord.
